memory: I've been lucky enough to have had some amazing travel experiences throughout my college years. One of my favorite trips was to Japan during spring break. It was a dream come true to explore the vibrant cities, try delicious food, and immerse myself in the unique culture. Visiting Tokyo's famous districts like Shibuya and Harajuku was a highlight, and I also enjoyed relaxing in the serene gardens of Kyoto. The experience was truly unforgettable. Another memorable trip was to Costa Rica, where I spent a week volunteering at a wildlife sanctuary. It was incredible to be surrounded by nature and contribute to conservation efforts. The scenic views and thrilling zip-lining adventures only added to the excitement. These experiences have not only broadened my horizons but also taught me valuable lessons about resilience, adaptability, and the importance of giving back. I feel grateful for the opportunities I've had and look forward to creating more memories in the future.I've been lucky enough to have had some amazing travel experiences throughout my college years.
